question: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular octagon?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon**, the sum of all **exterior angles** is always 360°.

Measure of each **exterior angle** = 360° ÷ n (where n is the **number of sides**).

For a **regular octagon**, n = 8.

⇒ Angle = 360° ÷ 8 = 45°.

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Shape is a **regular octagon**.

**Formula Used:** Exterior Angle = 360° / n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76b71662f80a3609d2d6bab594dc7d700ba358ea19add480cdf504a645d201bd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of sides (n) in an **octagon** = 8

⇒ Sum of all **exterior angles** of a polygon = 360°

⇒ Measure of each **exterior angle** = 360° ÷ 8

⇒ Measure of each **exterior angle** = 45°

**∴ The correct answer is 45°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle Formula

The measure of each **interior angle** of a **regular polygon** is given by [(n − 2) × 180°] / n.

Relationship between Angles

At any vertex, the **Interior Angle** + **Exterior Angle** = 180° (Linear Pair).

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all **interior angles** of a polygon with n sides is (n − 2) × 180°.</p
